lines: Follow this page to get timely alerts on
Students pursuing a master's degree in the UK
A fully-funded scholarship for the course for a year and other benefits

Chevening Scholarships 2026-27 is an opportunity provided by the Government of the United Kingdom in collaboration with the UK Universities to provide financial assistance to Indian students with outstanding leadership and influencing skills who wish to pursue a one-year master's degree in any subject at any UK university. Selected candidates will receive a fully-funded scholarship for a year for the course and other benefits.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be a citizen of a Chevening-eligible country or territory, including India
hold an undergraduate degree that enables entry into a postgraduate program at a UK university before applying (
This is typically equivalent to an upper second-class 2:1 honours degree in the UK, but can vary depending on the course and university choice.)
have at least two years of work experience (equivalent to 2,800 hours)
return to India for a minimum of two years after the scholarship ends
Applicants who hold refugee status in a Chevening-eligible country are eligible for a scholarship.
Only work experience gained after the date of graduation will count towards the two-year requirement.
Selected candidates will receive the following benefits:-
Travel costs to and from the UK
The cost of one visa application
A travel grant to attend Chevening events in the UK
An unconditional offer letter from a UK university
Names of two referees who know the applicant in a professional or academic capacity

The applicants will be shortlisted for an interview by the British embassies and high commissions.
The reference must be written in English.
All applicants need to register as new users, regardless of whether they have applied previously.
Once submitted, applications cannot be edited. Therefore, applicants are advised to fill out the form carefully.
Applications found ineligible for the scholarship will be removed from the selection process.
Interviews will be conducted in a city/town where the British Embassy or High Commission has representation.
Skype interviews are permitted in exceptional cases.

Work experience includes full-time or part-time employment, paid or unpaid internships, and voluntary work. However, mandatory internships or work placements integrated into a degree program do not count.
Candidates will not be eligible for the scholarship if they:
Hold British or dual British citizenship (unless they are citizens of a British Overseas Territory or hold BN(O) status and are applying from Hong Kong).
Hold refugee status in a non-Chevening-eligible country.
Have previously studied in the UK with funding from a UK government-funded scholarship.
Are you an employee, former employee, or relative of an employee of Her Majesty’s Government, or have been within the last two years from the opening of Chevening applications.

This includes employees of the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, all British Embassies/High Commissions, the Home Office, the Ministry of Defence, the Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy, the Department for International Trade, and UKVI, as well as the British Council, a sponsoring UK university, or staff members of the Association of Commonwealth Universities.
Candidates with a master's degree can apply for a second master's if they can demonstrate how it will further their career goals and positively impact their home country.

Relatives are defined as parents or step-parents, siblings or step-siblings, children or step-children, spouse, civil partner or unmarried partner (where the couple has been in a relationship akin to marriage or civil partnership for at least two years).
Question: Who is offering this opportunity?
The Government of the UK in collaboration with the UK Universities, is offering this opportunity.
This scholarship is meant for one year of support.
Question: Are there extra benefits for disabled students?
All candidates will receive equal benefits.
Question: Is there any application cost?
No, the application is free of cost.
Question: What is the mode of application?
The application is online through the official scholarship website.
